From today, Runna subscribers can use the newly launched "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna launches training tool to support running in hot weather

Personal running coach app Runna today announced three updates designed to support users throughout their entire training cycle — from training in hot weather to post-race recovery, leaving nothing uncovered.

Officially launching today, the "Adapt for Heat" feature helps users find cooler times to run and suggests adjusted pace targets based on felt air temperature, training duration, and the specific session.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature comes with colour-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to find the most suitable running times at a glance, so they can plan their training accordingly.

Runna shared the following about this new feature:

Runna has also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature — the moment users open a training plan for a 5km to 50km race, the system will automatically build a recovery plan for them. Runna Head Coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury".

Finally, the platform announced that a brand-new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-schedule multiple training plans and seamlessly move on to the next one automatically after completing a plan, further simplifying long-term training management.

Runna explained the advantages of "Upcoming Plans" as follows:

Plan a full year of training in minutes: runners can layer multiple races, transition goals, and training phases to see their entire year of training at a glance. Zero admin between plans: no need to rebuild or start from scratch — preferred training schedules, predicted finishing times, and current fitness levels all carry over automatically when one plan ends and the next begins. Flexible and fully in control: every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: every plan is designed by Runna's experienced coaches based on proven training principles, helping runners keep improving, recover fully, and be race-day ready.
